english.title: Filled space at authorised standing - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), filled a space at an authorised standing at Liverpool John Lennon Airport, laid out or marked so that taxis may only stand one behind the other, other than in accordance with the procedure for filling vacancies outlined in byelaw 7(10) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022 in that **(..SPECIFY METHOD OF FILLING SPACE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 7(10) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
